name: Citizens Bancorp Investment, Inc.
summary: Citizens Bancorp Investment, Inc. is a Tennessee-based financial institution offering a comprehensive range of banking and financial services. Its core offerings include essential deposit accounts like checking and savings, alongside certificates of deposit (CDs) and individual retirement accounts (IRAs). Clients also benefit from modern conveniences such as credit and debit cards, overdraft facilities, instant transaction processing, and accessible digital banking through online and mobile platforms. The company further provides tailored cash management and various personal and business solutions designed for both individual and commercial customers. Beyond these, the institution facilitates diverse lending options, including personal, mortgage, construction, agricultural, commercial, and officers' loans. Wealth management services are also a key component of their portfolio. With a network of 22 banking offices, the company predominantly serves Bedford, Clay, Coffee, DeKalb, Franklin, Jackson, Macon, Overton, Putnam, Smith, Sumner, and Wilson counties, as well as neighboring areas throughout Middle Tennessee. Citizens Bancorp Investment, Inc. was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Lafayette, Tennessee.
